title: Leaf Protein Extraction
author: Steven J Burgess
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bqnmmvc6
materials: Grind tissue for 00:01:30 at 20 Hz Warning: Do not exceed this frequency, higher frequencies increase the number of cases where the steel beads will break the lid of centrifuge tubes resulting in sample loss. If using the SPEX 2150 beads it is necessary to use 2 mL centrifuge tubes to ensure proper grinding, in 1.5 mL tubes the bead will not reach the tapered bottom leaving samples unground TissueLyser II (Bead Mill, QIAGEN, 85300, https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/human-id-and-forensics/automation/tissuelyser-ii/#orderinginformation )

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the 1x PEB buffer from the 4x stock.

substeps.instruction: If stored at 4 °C, incubate 4x PEB at 50 °C for 00:20:00 to re-suspend precipitated SDS.
Dilute 4x stock with dH2O to make 500 µL of 1x PEB per sample (it is advised to make more than necessary).

steps.title: Pre-cool Grinding Equipment
steps.instruction: Cool the grinding beads and inserts to ensure sample stability.

substeps.instruction: Pre-cool 4mm SPEX stainless steel grinding beads at -80 °C for 00:30:00.
Pre-cool TissueLyser inserts for LN2 for 00:30:00.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Tubes
steps.instruction: Assemble the tubes for tissue lysis using cryogenic tools.

substeps.instruction: Using forceps cooled in LN2, add one SPEX bead per sample tube.
Insert tubes into pre-cooled TissueLyser II cassettes, ensuring a balanced number of samples between cassettes.
Remove cassettes from TissueLyser II and submerge them in LN2 to prevent thawing.

steps.title: Grind Leaf Tissue
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt the tissue using the TissueLyser II.

substeps.instruction: Check for samples sticking to the edge of tubes; repeat grinding if tissue is not properly ground.

steps.title: Handle Ground Samples
steps.instruction: Remove and stabilize the ground tissue.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes with forceps cooled in LN2.
Either store samples at -80 °C for several months or allow them to sit on dry ice for 30 mins before proceeding to avoid slow thawing/resuspension.

steps.title: Extract Proteins
steps.instruction: Resuspend the ground powder in extraction buffer and denature proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add 450 µL 1x PEB to ground powder (3x 1cm leaf disk).
Vortex immediately at maximum speed for approximately 00:01:00 until no lumps are visible.
Heat samples at 95 °C for 00:05:00 to denature proteins and inactivate proteases.
Vortex heated samples at maximum speed for 00:00:05 to shear nucleic acids.

steps.title: Clarify Extract
steps.instruction: Separate the soluble protein fraction from insoluble debris.

substeps.instruction: Spin samples for 00:03:00 at 10000 x g at room temperature.
Verify pellet color (should be white/light-grey; intense green indicates suboptimal disruption).
Transfer supernatant to a new 1.5 mL centrifuge tube, avoiding carry-over of debris.
Transfer supernatant to ice or store at -20 °C for up to a month.
